synopsis: When you get summoned to another world, things are supposed to go a certain way: become a hero, battle monsters, and slay demons, right? Now he can breakfast with its beautiful denizens, learn magic with the help of a spunky demon girl, go to barbeques, and so much more! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Although she started her life as a "Master Jewel," she was not able to help people as much as she would like. Then she meets Alecrea, a master jeweler who is rumored to be a "Jewel Killer." The unpredictable buddy and love fantasy between a girl with black iron and a rebellious young man begins! (Source: Pixiv Sylph, translated)

synopsis: University student Mimi and her boyfriend Naoto encounter one chilling mystery after another. There’s the enigmatic neighbor woman dressed in black from head to toe—but if she’s so odd, why does it seems like there are many others like her? Then, whose eyes track Mimi’s movements from the cemetery next door? And why does a bizarre red circle drawn on a basement wall change with each passing day? Nine scary stories that really happened, drawn from the famed collection of urban legends Shin Mimibukuro (New Earmuffs), and adapted into manga by horror genius Junji Ito! Chapter 1: On the Utility Pole Chapter 2: The Woman Next Door Chapter 3: Rustling in the Grass Chapter 4: Grave Placement Chapter 5: Seashore Chapter 6: Just the Two of Us Chapter 7: Scarlet Circle Chapter 8: Sign in the Field Chapter 9: Monster Prop (Source: VIZ Media)

synopsis: The protagonists of "Chie Aru Koibito," Ushidome-kun and Shirakaba-san, are both intelligent class representatives who judge things rationally. Even though their classmates extol the two as a perfect match, Shirakaba-san declares that she "doesn't have even a second to lose herself in love." Ushidome-kun is honestly shocked by this, but he also appeals that he is "not in a state to fall in love," which upsets Shirakaba-san. They are both too conscious of each other, and the rationality of the two explosive people is on the verge of collapse. This is the love story of a male and female honor student who cannot be honest with each other and are tormented by their own worldly desires. (Source: Natalie, translated)
